title: Capital Flows — DC columns as HY ↔ borrowing rotation
notes: v35 clean DC model. Each Digital Credit column is a constant rotation between HY buffer and borrowing (Morpho / margin), gated by LTV vs target. Liquidity enters → immediate allocate to spot collateral. LTV below target → additional principal parks in HY. LTV above target → HY tops spot collateral. Spine L→R: Income → DC·BTC → LE (cash/credit) → DC·Equities → Deploy. Cross-map dual-leverage extract stays dashed/optional.
